// about: Sample mapping scheme for the Instance Migrator plugin, authored from the Sample Kit Playground pair below. It demonstrates the case Figma's native swap cannot handle: a layer that MOVED INTO A SLOT. Structures were read from the live file; see agentNotes for what is verified and what still needs filling in.
// map: Old nodePath -> new nodePath, or null to drop. The third entry is the whole point of this sample: `Inverse-button` was a direct child of the root and is now nested inside the `action-slot` SLOT, so no name- or path-based heuristic finds it.

map.note: Unchanged path. Listed for self-documentation; it would auto-map.
Unchanged path. Carries the snackbar's text override.
REPARENTED. Old: direct child of the root instance. New: inside the `action-slot` SLOT. This is the mapping native swap drops.
The red overlay marking the component as deprecated. It has no counterpart in the replacement, by design — dropped deliberately.

// props: Empty on purpose. Both component sets expose the SAME variant properties with the same names (Configuration, # of lines, Show close affordance), and identically-named props are applied automatically — so there is nothing to rename, retype or drop.
// values: Empty on purpose. Every old value has a 1:1 path target in the new tree (see map[]); nothing has to become a property, merge or split.
// slots: Old SLOT path -> new SLOT path. REQUIRED here rather than optional: the plugin auto-matches a slot by identical path, then by unique leaf name, then by being the sole slot on both sides. All three fail for this pair — the paths differ, the leaf names differ (`slot` vs `bottom slot`), and the new component has TWO slots — so without this entry the plugin correctly refuses to guess and reports the slot unmatched.

slots.note: Whatever the designer dropped into the old `slot` is rebuilt into `bottom slot`. Note the new slot ships hidden; the restore makes it visible by placing content in it.

// drop: Old paths whose overrides are knowingly discarded. Silences the 'unmapped' warning and records that it was a decision.
agentNotes: VERIFIED from the live file (Sample Kit Playground, zO662vC0476nlRFJg85RBR) via Figma Dev Mode: both subtrees were read node by node. Old = content{Supporting text, slot{stuff, Rectangle 1}}, Inverse-button, deprecated. New = content{Supporting text, bottom slot}, action-slot{Inverse-button}.
